decisions.reason: This LED track spotlight line, launched in 2023 and still presented on its own page, is central to the firm's modular track system and is unlikely to be withdrawn this early.
This established-style LED ceiling luminaire line supports the broad range and the dealer business, and with only about two years on the market it still has a normal lifecycle ahead.
This flexible LED spotlight line was launched only in 2024, has its own page, and fits the firm's flexible-system strategy, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
This multi-outlet ceiling canopy is a system accessory that enables pendant combinations across the range and is cheap to keep listed.
This low-voltage multi-outlet canopy serves a niche but complements the low-voltage system components, and it is recent, so keeping it is the expected choice.
These round glass track luminaires are only mentioned rather than featured, which suggests a slightly weaker market position, but as a 2024 line close to the core offer it will likely be kept.
